report_name: NTT Docomo Confirms Data Breach Potentially Affecting 300,000 Customers

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Attackers gained unauthorized external access to NTT Docomo's systems by targeting its customer-facing web applications: the 'Docomo Online Shop' and the 'My docomo' portal.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: The attackers accessed backend database systems to obtain customer data, including PII and financial details.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exfiltrated a large volume of sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and financial data after gaining access to customer records.

campaigns.name: NTT Docomo Data Breach November 2026
campaigns.description: An unnamed campaign targeting Japanese telecommunications giant NTT Docomo in November 2026, resulting in the compromise of up to 300,000 customers' personal and financial data through an attack on its public-facing web portals.

identities.name: NTT Docomo
identities.description: Japan's largest mobile carrier, victim of a cyberattack that exposed the personal data of up to 300,000 customers by targeting its 'My docomo' portal and online shop.

indicators.name: Web Server Process Accessing Sensitive System Files
indicators.pattern:
title: Web Server Process Accessing Sensitive System Files
id: 2b1a987c-c8d3-4e5f-a0b9-1f2d3e4c5b6a
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects a web server process spawning shell commands to read sensitive system files like /etc/passwd. This can indicate a web shell or RCE vulnerability exploitation.
references:
  - Internal hunting hint from NTT Docomo breach analysis
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-05
tags:
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/httpd'
      - '/apache2'
      - '/nginx'
      - '/php-fpm'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/cat'
      - '/head'
      - '/tail'
      - '/more'
      - '/less'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/etc/passwd'
      - '/etc/shadow'
  condition: all of selection_*

indicators.name: Anomalous Bulk Database Selection
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Bulk Database Selection
id: 9f8e7d6c-5b4a-4c3d-8e7f-6a5b4c3d2e1f
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects database queries that select all columns from a table, especially from a web application source, which could indicate a data exfiltration attempt.
references:
  - Internal hunting hint from NTT Docomo breach analysis
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-05
tags:
  - attack.t1213
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: database
detection:
  selection:
    query|contains|all:
      - 'SELECT * FROM'
    query|contains:
      - 'customers'
      - 'users'
      - 'accounts'
  filter_legit:
    source_address:
      - '127.0.0.1'
      - '::1'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
